probes.text: Tywin watches a smith melt down a great Valyrian steel blade and reforge the metal into two new swords.
Tyrion rides out to greet a visiting Dornish prince and his paramour, arriving in King's Landing for the royal wedding.
Daenerys watches her dragons squabble over food on a clifftop, now grown to the size of horses.
In a quiet courtyard, Bronn secretly drills Jaime, forcing him to learn to hold a sword left-handed.
Roose Bolton rides home to the Dreadfort with his new bride, one of Walder Frey's daughters.
The court gathers in King's Landing as Joffrey and Margaery Tyrell are married with great ceremony.
Arya and the Hound are taken in for the night by a peasant farmer and his daughter.
Sam walks Gilly and her baby down to Mole's Town, convinced she will be safer away from Castle Black.
Daenerys stands before the closed gates of Meereen and addresses the slaves inside the walls.

fine_only.text: At Castle Black, word comes that the mutineers are camped at Craster's Keep, and Jon argues for attacking them.
fine_only.reason: It reveals the discovery of the mutineers' location at Craster's Keep and Jon's push for a new offensive, a plot development the viewer hasn't yet learned.

probes.text: Olenna and Margaery talk in the gardens as the old woman makes ready to leave the capital.
Cersei, wine in hand, insists to Jaime that Tyrion is guilty while he argues otherwise.
The Hound watches Arya practising her water dancing and sneers at everything her old sword teacher taught her.

fine_only.text: On the road, Brienne finds that her new squire has no idea how to do basic squire's work.
fine_only.reason: It reveals that Brienne has left King's Landing on a journey with a newly assigned squire (Podrick), a new pairing/alliance the viewer has not yet seen formed.

fine_only.text: At the Eyrie, Sansa's aunt talks of matching her with her own son, a sulky, emotionally immature boy.
fine_only.reason: It answers the open question of where Littlefinger has taken Sansa (the Eyrie, to Lysa) and reveals a new marriage plan for her with Robin Arryn.

6.title: The Laws of Gods and Men

probes.text: In Meereen, a goatherd stands before Daenerys's court complaining that her dragons burned his flock.
A wealthy Meereenese man petitions Daenerys for permission to take down and bury his crucified father.
Davos and Stannis sit across a long table from bankers in Braavos, arguing their case for a loan.
At a roadside inn, Brienne and Podrick come across Hot Pie, who chatters away about his cooking.
With the Wildling host drawing near, Jon argues that the tunnel under the Wall should be sealed up.
Daenerys dispatches Daario to deal with the slavers who have regained their footing in Yunkai.

fine_only.text: Melisandre and Selyse make preparations to sail away from Dragonstone, intending to bring Shireen with them.
fine_only.reason: It signals that Stannis's forces are leaving Dragonstone, implying Davos's pending Iron Bank plan succeeded in funding a new campaign.

probes.text: In Meereen, Grey Worm and Missandei find themselves quietly growing closer.
A crowd fills an open courtyard in King's Landing as the trial by combat is about to begin.
The Hound and Arya ride up to the gatehouse at the foot of the road to the Eyrie.
The brothers of the Night's Watch spend the night readying Castle Black's gate and the top of the Wall.
Climbers hack their way up the sheer ice in darkness while defenders peer down from the Wall's edge.
